historical_context.time_period: Early Pallas Species Strikes era, 2719-2724; one ordinary morning before Kappa route release
historical_context.location: Pallas Yard Twelve, the line-issue alcove off the loop-outer worker staging side of Service Ring Kappa
historical_context.summary: A BioDrone Standard worker discovers that the official serial matches while the physical limiter coupler does not. The shift must choose whether a private object name becomes evidence, stays inside a quiet return practice, or yields to a clean issue record that exports the cost into the worker's body.

public_facts.text: AU Pallas yards place VitaForge biodrones, BioElevate uplift lines, baseline workers, supervisors, and local contractors inside one maintenance ecology while administering them through separate liability categories.
BioDrone Standard interfaces can carry instruction, authorization, diagnostic information, compliance enforcement, legal exposure, and memory-continuity risk.

Pallas line kits are individually fitted but remain split among AU route control, VitaForge interface records, and contractor maintenance; workers use private names and secondary return marks to catch physical mismatches that serial ledgers miss.
Service Ring Kappa receives workers through a shift gate, timekeeping, equipment issue, and muster corridor; authority reaches the ring by a cleaner gallery route.

ambient_pressures.text: A route clock converts careful fitting and mutual aid into lost minutes, claimshare pressure, and an answerable worker name.
An official incident can protect Nara from a behavioral-drift interpretation while exposing the workers and clerk who maintained the unofficial continuity layer.
Teth and Orrin can help from their own bodily and labor positions without collapsing uplift, baseline, and biodrone categories into one legal status.

material_incentives: Keep helpers out of supplier discipline
internal_virtues: Returning a fitting to its usual wearer
internal_shames: Trusting a green ledger over a known body
Letting a helper carry all audit exposure
prestige_markers: Recognizing a part by sound or scratch
Catching a swap before route release
emotional_display_norms: Concern travels through object inspection, clipped correction, shared marks, and work jokes more readily than confession.
trust_defaults: Trusts repeated physical fit and cross-shift return memory before supplier serial cleanliness.

groups.label: AU line-issue and timekeeping staff
institutional_logic: Release only bodies, kits, routes, and return obligations that agree on the shift slate.
internal_shames: An unofficial board visible on camera
prestige_markers: A correction that does not travel upward
taboo_triggers: A local kindness becoming an auditable network
emotional_display_norms: Care is compressed into moving a board, lowering a voice, or failing to notice one useful act.
trust_defaults: Trusts official tags publicly and experienced clerks' physical memory privately.

groups.label: Service Ring Kappa mixed maintenance shift
institutional_logic: Keep one pressure-and-thermal service circuit working through distinct bodies, contracts, and technical authorities.
material_incentives: Send correctly fitted workers through safe routes
Keep return knowledge available next shift
internal_virtues: Mutual aid too ordinary to announce
internal_shames: Leaving another body to pay for a clean schedule
prestige_markers: A support rig understood by its wearer
A queue cleared without sacrificing fit
taboo_triggers: A supervisor treating distinct support needs as one supplier problem
emotional_display_norms: Solidarity appears first as a witness signature, a return knot, or a tool placed within reach.
trust_defaults: Trusts shift competence locally while legal categories remain divided.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Workers name calibrated fittings they cannot own because the name preserves a material history the supplier ledger can overwrite.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Keep names tied to visible scratches, sounds, fit, and custody instead of treating naming as mystical personhood proof.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: The issue counter rewards agreement among tags, kit, route, and return fields even when physical fit contradicts the slate.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Make administrative pressure visible through the clock, camera, hatch, and limited correction options.

observer_read: Behavior attached to an inventory discrepancy
misread_patterns: Treats object identity as whatever the active serial says
Treats a fit report as behavior until a baseline witness names the metal
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Let the same private name protect bodily fit and increase audit exposure.

observer_read: A clerk who can sometimes misplace his attention usefully
target_self_read: Local steward of supplier inventory and route readiness
misread_patterns: Workers may overestimate how long a sympathetic clerk can keep a second board off-camera
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Keep Eli's help bounded by his counter authority and career exposure.

role_pressure_fields.summary: A VitaForge engineered worker who knows one familiar coupler through repeated bodily fit and must decide whether that knowledge becomes evidence.
obligations: Leave the next shift a usable return trail
failure_modes: Quietly fixing one object while losing the next

role_pressure_fields.summary: A baseline worker who controls local kit release but not supplier title, AU claimshare policy, or later incident review.
failure_modes: Making helper names the incident instead of the mismatch
Pretending the counter has no discretion

known_context.text: Nara knows Rain-Again through repeated fit, sound, scratch, and the private return board; she knows the Kappa shift route and the cost of missing release.

beliefs.text: Nara treats object naming as a practical continuity claim, not as formal title or a complete political program.

misreads.text: Nara may underestimate how quickly an incident record can turn a mutual-aid trace into a list of helpers.

must_not_know.text: Nara must not speak as if the later Awakened Labor Front has already interpreted this counter practice for her.

known_context.text: Eli can see the official issue slate, physical fittings at his counter, route clock, camera state, and the local second board.

beliefs.text: Eli believes a bounded correction is survivable when it does not force the counter to own the whole personhood dispute.

misreads.text: Eli may treat private names as unusually accurate inventory slang while missing their social meaning to the workers who use them.

must_not_know.text: Eli must not know whether every named fitting practice elsewhere on Pallas has the same meaning or participants.

known_context.text: Teth knows harness-side sightlines, tactile return knots, and the bodily stakes of supplier-owned support equipment, but not VitaForge's private diagnostic record.

beliefs.text: Teth treats the right fitting as a shift safety fact across supplier categories.

must_not_know.text: Teth must not be flattened into a generic biodrone or made subject to VitaForge BioDrone Standard provenance.

author_only_boundaries.text: The routine may foreshadow later Pallas coordination, but the characters do not know it will matter historically and do not call it a movement.
Nara's engineered humanoid form is fixture-local continuity from the existing Pallas draft, not a universal BioDrone Standard body plan.

open_questions.question: How portable are Pallas private line-kit names across yards and VitaForge service contractors?
open_questions.notes: The lore patch establishes the practice at Pallas ramps and leaves its exact spread, vocabulary, and later formalization open.

open_questions.question: What exact contract form governs AU's use of a BioDrone Standard worker's body in this yard?
open_questions.notes: The fixture says AU rents the shift from VitaForge, not that one universal lease form owns all biodrone bodies. Supplier title and administrative personhood remain broader setting questions.
